news.title: Anthropic prices IPO at $83, debuts on Nasdaq today under ANT
news.text: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83/share, above the marketed $70-78 range, and began trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market today under ticker ANT - the largest IPO on record. Nasdaq-100 futures were indicated up roughly 2% premarket on the news, a bounce after Wednesday's hawkish-Fed-minutes selloff.

news.title: Chip and memory stocks rally on Anthropic-fueled AI-trade optimism
news.text: Nvidia, AMD, Micron, SanDisk and Western Digital all rose this morning (Micron/SanDisk roughly +4%, Western Digital +5%, Nvidia +1.5%, AMD +2.9% per one source) as Anthropic's above-range IPO pricing revived risk appetite in AI-linked names after this week's selloff.

news.title: Alphabet's pre-IPO Anthropic stake re-rates higher as ANT prices above expectations
news.text: Reuters estimated Alphabet's roughly 14% Anthropic stake (about $33B invested) would be worth close to $139B if ANT priced at $78; today's $83 print implies an even larger mark-up. GOOGL is +3.0% in early trading, among the stronger watch-list movers today.

news.title: Hawkish October Fed minutes drove Wednesday's selloff; VIX still elevated
news.text: Minutes from the Fed's 28 Oct meeting, released this week, showed most officials see rates needing to rise further - a hawkish surprise that helped send the Dow down 561pts (-1.11%) and the S&P 500 down 0.23% on Wednesday. VIX eased to 22.69 today (FMP) from Wednesday's 24.56 close, still above its 50-day average of 17.82.
